args.body:
Dear Litware Team,

Thank you for your patience. We have processed your refund request for **$310**, corresponding to the reshipping fee incurred due to the incorrect shipment to your site.

**Refund Details:**
- Amount: **$310**
- Expected Processing Time: **3–5 business days**

**Resolution:** The hardware has been confirmed reshipped to the correct site (**Pune DC**).

Please allow 5 business days for the refund to reflect in your original payment method. If you have any further questions, reply to this email or contact our support team.

Best regards,
The IT-Ops Team
